fields.Name: D1c -> S8.1
fields.Description: Gate G6.1 (owner PR 4, phase 6, dataset D1c, criterion S8.1): every D1c prediction whose label window closed has a joined outcome row, 100%. A model trained on periods 0-2 is published, bound and scored as of each of periods 3-5; PredictiveStudio.RunModelMonitoring runs each period and the MJ: ML Monitoring Results row counts the closed-window predictions (scored less training rows) and the joined ones.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Every closed-window prediction has a joined outcome (joined equals closedWindowPredictions).
